title: AIOS AutoResearch v0.2 Live Browser-Session Invocation Record
description: One record per actual live browser-session model call made by scripts/autoresearch_live_browser_adapter.py (issue #413, parent #409). Additive to v0.1: it does NOT modify schemas/autoresearch_observation_row.schema.json or schemas/autoresearch_experiment_record.schema.json (both frozen, additionalProperties:false, version const). The shadow runner (scripts/autoresearch_shadow_runner.py) only needs `response` + `runtime_model_configuration` on an adapter row, so live-provenance fields ride alongside without a v0.1 schema change. Governed by docs/standards/AUTORESEARCH_V02_LIVE_CONTRACT.md (issue #411, reused unchanged): browser UI execution exposes very little, so unobservable fields are the literal strings `not_observable` / `not_captured`, never guessed.

transport_id.description: `playwright_mcp` for a real live call; `fake_browser` for the deterministic test double (which can never be labelled live).

transport_mode.description: Exactly one connection mode is implemented for v0.2.

browser_session_ref.description: Non-secret logical identifier/hash only. Never a cookie, token, storage-state blob, or a profile path containing user information.

model.description: The UI-observed model selector value when the target UI exposes one; otherwise the literal `not_observable`. Never inferred from a default selector, account plan, product name, or URL.

model_identity_status.description: The comparator must distinguish these three. `verified` = an authoritative integration surface confirmed identity; `ui_observed` = read from a visible selector; `not_observable` = the UI/runtime did not expose it.

termination_status.description: Only `completed` can support a live observation PASS. Every other value preserves a sanitized record and maps downstream to inconclusive/rejected.

response_text_or_ref.description: Sanitized captured answer (or an external reference to it). null for any non-`completed` termination.

response_hash.description: sha256 of the normalised captured answer. null for any non-`completed` termination. Never a placeholder hash.

cost_amount.description: 0 for a browser-session transport under the owner's $0 / plan-included Phase 0 authorization. AutoResearch adds no per-call fee; target-account usage is tracked separately by the owner.

retry_of.description: null unless this invocation is the one explicitly-allowed bounded retry of a prior invocation_id.

authority_evidence_ref.description: Pointer to the recorded owner authorization envelope for this batch. Required and non-empty; `invoke` refuses to submit without it.

limitations.description: Always begins with the fixed repo_replay non-equivalence statement; may append the specific non-pass reason.

allOf.description: A non-completed termination carries no response and no hash.
A completed termination must carry a real captured answer and a real hash.
A test-double capture is never labelled as a live provider transport.
The one real live transport always captures by browser automation.
